summary: Full backend + frontend testing of RX Tech B2B medicine marketplace. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth (send-otp, verify-otp, onboard, /me), dashboard, distributors, products, cart CRUD, orders placement & filtering, payments, returns, shortbook. Frontend: Verified end-to-end flow on mobile viewport (390x844) — splash → email → OTP (dev banner) → onboarding → home dashboard → all 5 tabs (Home/Vendors/Orders/Payments/More) → search → product detail → add to cart → cart screen → orders list with status tabs → payments with pay buttons → more menu (profile, shortbook, returns, logout). All UI integrations with backend confirmed working. Currency formatting ₹ INR correct everywhere.

issues: Bottom tab bar buttons have no testID on the Tabs.Screen entries — tab navigation in tests requires URL navigation (/home, /orders etc.) or matching label text which can be ambiguous. Recommend adding tabBarTestID per tab in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx for robust e2e testing.

react_native_issues.issue: Hidden OTP boxes are rendered with width=0/visibility hidden — Playwright cannot directly click/fill non-first boxes; supports paste-into-first which works. No functional issue, but Playwright .fill on element handles fails — page.keyboard.type after focus works. Acceptable.

action_items: (Optional) Add tabBarTestID to each Tabs.Screen in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx for easier UI test selectors.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — track down the offending component (likely a 3rd-party). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id field via projection {'_id': 0} in all queries.
JWT secret falls back to a default 'rxtech-dev-secret-change-in-prod' — fine for preview, must be set as env var in production.
DEV_RETURN_OTP=True is hard-coded; consider making it env-driven for production safety.
server.py is ~720 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, catalog, cart, orders, payments) when adding more endpoints.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; api client centralised in /app/frontend/src/api.ts.
All interactive elements on auth/onboarding/tabs/payments/orders/cart screens have testIDs.
seed_data_creation: Each test login creates a new user via test+<timestamp>@pharmacy.com. Backend auto-seeds distributors+products once and per-user orders/payments/returns/shortbook on first verify-otp. No manual seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mocked: Email OTP delivery — dev_otp returned in API response (documented). To authenticate in playwright tests: (1) POST /api/auth/send-otp with unique email — devOtp is also passed in the redirected URL as ?devOtp=NNNNNN. (2) For OTP screen, use page.evaluate to focus inputs[0] then page.keyboard.type(otp) (paste-into-first works). (3) Onboarding has testIDs: onb-name, onb-phone, onb-shop, onb-gst. (4) Tab nav is NOT testID-tagged — use direct URL navigation: /home, /vendors, /orders, /payments, /more. (5) Status tabs in orders have testIDs orders-tab-{all|placed|processing|shipped|delivered}. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_rxtech_backend.py — fully reusable.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Implementation matches spec — splash routes to /auth/email when no token, OTP flow shows dev banner, onboarding requires name+phone, dashboard shows all 6 sections (today_orders, payment_due, ai_insights, deliveries, action_required, profit_opportunities), tabs render all 5 sections, search → product → cart → place order → orders list all integrated correctly with backend grouping by distributor.
